about_the_game:
Tears of the Maker is a roguelite deck builder with Pachinko-inspired gameplay. It requires a good use of card combinations and planning in order to defeat your enemies and take control of your fate.

Tears flow to the chambers to determine who takes damage. Use the cards to manipulate various aspects of the game to gain the advantage. Every run is different. Having a well rounded deck is the key to success.
